label: Orders
caption: TOTH, WILLIAM, ET AL. V. CHAPMAN, LEIGH, ET AL.
text: The application for writ of injunction presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court in No. 21A457 is denied. This case has now been referred to a three-judge court, and the parties may exercise their right to appeal from an order of that court granting or denying interlocutory injunctive relief.
